task: Cover the seat picker (`/`): twelve seats A1 to C4, with A1, B3 and C4 already taken. Clicking a free seat selects it, which its aria-pressed reports as true, and lists it in the Selected line (`Selected: A2, B1`); clicking it again deselects it. At most 4 seats can be selected: a fifth click shows `You can pick up to 4 seats` and selects nothing. The legend (`Selected 2 · Available 7 · Taken 3`) follows every change. Reserve turns the selected seats into taken seats (disabled and counted as Taken), shows `Reserved A2, B1`, and clears the selection; reservations are stored on the server and survive a reload.
